pairs.subject: analytics-store-design
pairs.evidence: src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:8 This context only emits navigation usage events to a fire-and-forget Sentry sink (a local SQLite sink is listed only as 'later' on the next line); it owns no events table, index, timestamp encoding or multi-backend query surface, and a search of src/lib/analytics/ for CREATE INDEX, toISOString, unsupported, partition and created_at found nothing.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:70 The sink interface is write-only (feature/interaction/session/conversion return void). No read methods means no query semantics for backends to keep in parity.
src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:107 The only capability-like flag is consent (noop vs live sink), not a query-serving capability. No query surface can be refused.
src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:21 Events are in-memory transport payloads handed to Sentry. No fact table is designed here.
